status: Design only; source frozen pending candidate37. Root has received proposed direction.
problem: Actual InitialEditorSession uses retain(optional fillStopping3D). A later refusal inside a mode2 callback would discard the local current-page widget updates, even if coordinate allocation or COW effects had already happened. Current successful-only snapshot helper does not establish this failure projection.
native_consumed_control_order: After the dimension visibility/combo-shape prefix (still separately qualified), fill TMAX, SMAX0..2, VMIN0..2, LMAX0..2, EMAX in this order.
Clear both reference selectors, insert None, append eligible objects, set both selected indices, run eb6440 for first and second.
Run ebe100 first invocation, then second. Each can change radio/spin state and invoke node-coordinate callbacks before its final stored-coordinate text fill.
Only afterward assign MDS mode combo, threshold text, and the rotation selector/control tail.
proposed_api: StoppingFillReport fillStopping3DInto(StoppingPage& destination, const SimControl&, GuiModel&, NumericLocale);
api_semantics: The destination supplies retained widgets; it is the same page owned by InitialEditorSession. No clone of its owner or hidden default label context.
Return report separates completed supported projection from a reached unsupported dependency, with stage, issue, current reference/invocation and node-getter counts for scientific acceptance.
Update the destination in original consumed-control order. After a refusal, keep reached page state and model prefix effects; never fabricate tail values.
Preserve existing optional overloads as explicit convenience wrappers that discard an incomplete local snapshot; only the actual composer uses the retaining API.
Store the last stopping fill report in InitialOpenReport or the session so its UnsupportedPage result identifies the specific reached dependency.
A source profile refusal is not an original application error. Unknown visibility, translator, parent/filter and later public constructor behavior remain qualified; no public300 guard removal.
node_profile_contract: Use same model/step/node-set owner identity, original signed node bounds and positive bounded spin values.
Apply original allocate/dispatch/sync ordering. Use bc::calloc_doubles for matching allocation diagnostics; retain calloc failure as a null callback result when modeled.
Read current GUI sync predicate after allocation and StateVar dispatch. False branches remain explicit until the audited defdbio reader receives the live GUI predicate.
Before each reached dereference, reject unsafe signed32 index/extent arithmetic instead of reproducing host UB. Preserve earlier calls and allocations.
Format all successful callback coordinates with %.6g, run the original first/second stack-vector evaluation, then let ebe100 overwrite with stored %.3f coordinates.
proposed_tests: Changed valid node with existing data succeeds; confirm exact getter counts and unchanged MDS model before Save.
Missing data with valid small owned extent allocates zeroed coordinates and retains that allocation after fill.
No-storage/zero-count getter returns false yet final stored MDS coordinate text and changed spin persist.
Reached GUI-sync or extent refusal retains scalar prefix, selector/radio/spin state and any earlier model allocation; threshold/rotation tail stays remembered.
Second reference refusal retains completed first reference; first/second same-object behavior and repeated-fill zero callback count.
Actual InitialEditorSession receives a partial stopping-page report at its original stage; earlier pages remain and Save stays refused.
